name: AntiNuke
author: kirin
description: AntiNuke monitors server events and automatically quarantines users who perform potentially destructive actions beyond configured thresholds. Features include channel/role monitoring, ban/kick detection, webhook monitoring, dangerous permission detection, vanity URL protection, guild prune detection, and bot addition detection with auto-kick option.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the antinuke cog!
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores trusted user IDs and quarantine records containing user IDs, prior role IDs, reasons, and timestamps per guild. Red data-deletion requests remove those records.
